caption: The drawing features two similar objects each composed of rectangular cast metal with rounded corners and four short legs. The upper object is illustrated from above, rendered in dark brown with the words "GERRYD HARPER" cut out in capital letters as part of the surface design, with geometric gaps between the letters and an elongated rectangular slot in the center. The lower object is shown in a three-quarters perspective, positioned diagonally on a white or light beige background, and is colored light beige or cream, with the same words and cutout design as the upper object. The background of the drawing is plain and unembellished except for a small printed caption reading "ROCCO DANTE NAVIGATO" near the bottom right.
title: Trivet
